proposed.text: A candidate scoring 65% in Design, 72% in Building Science, 78% in Professional Practice, and 71% in History achieves a 71.5% weighted average. Is this passing?

options.text: Yes, the weighted average of 71.5% exceeds 70%
No, the Design score of 65% does not meet the 70% threshold for each subject
Yes, but the candidate must retake Design to improve overall performance
No, the composite score lacks sufficient margin above 70%

rationale.b: Misapplies the threshold; the law requires 50% minimum per subject, not 70%; Design at 65% exceeds the 50% floor.
rationale.c: Invents non-existent requirements; passing the dual threshold means no mandatory retakes; the candidate has met all requirements.
rationale.d: Suggests an arbitrary margin requirement; RA 9266 establishes 70% as the passing standard, not a margin above 70%.
rationale.correct: The 70% weighted average is satisfied (71.5%), and no individual subject falls below 50% (Design is 65%, which exceeds 50%). Both thresholds are met, so the candidate passes.
rationale.takeaway: Passing criteria met: 71.5% weighted average + all subjects above 50% minimum = candidate passes.
